paite: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi a sam a, kihoupihna puan inn a kipan in a houpih a,
english: Yahweh “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. called to Moses, and spoke to him out of the Tent of Meeting, saying,

paite: Israel suante houph inla, a kiang uah, Na lak ua kuapeuh in thillat TOUPA kiang a na lat un, gan, bawng hon leh belam hon lak ate, na lat ding uh ahi.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When anyone of you offers an offering to Yahweh, you shall offer your offering of the livestock, from the herd and from the flock.

paite: A thillat pen bawng hon lak ate, haltum thillat a hih leh a pa, gensiatbei a lat ding ahi: amah TOUPA ma a pom a hih theihna ding in kihoupihna puan inn kongpi bul a lat ding ahi
english: “‘If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he shall offer a male without blemish. He shall offer it at the door of the Tent of Meeting, that he may be accepted before Yahweh.

paite: Huan, haltum thillat lu tungah a khut a koih ding a; huchi in amah a ding in lemna bawlna ding in pomsak ahi ding.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.

paite: Huan, TOUPA ma ah bawngpa a gou ding a; huan, Aron tapa, siampute'n sisan a lan ding ua, kihoupihna puan inn kongpi bul a maitam sisan in a theh ding uh ahi.
english: He shall kill the bull before Yahweh. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall present the blood and sprinkle the blood around on the altar that is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Huan, haltum thillat a lip ding a, a sem ding ahi.
english: He shall flay the burnt offering, and cut it into pieces.

paite: Huan, siampu Aron tapate'n maitam ah mei a koih ding ua, mei tungah sing achiangkhawm ding uh:
english: The sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on the altar, and lay wood in order on the fire;

paite: Huan, Aron tapa, siampute'n sabakte, a lute, a thaute maitam a mei tungah sing ah kilawmtak in a koih ding uh:
english: and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall lay the pieces, the head, and the fat in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar;

paite: A sungkuate leh a khete bel tui in a sil ding: siampu in TOUPA a ding gimlim tak, mei a lat haltum thillat ding in a pum in maitam ah a hal ding ahi.
english: but its innards and its legs he shall wash with water. The priest shall burn the whole on the altar, for a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

paite: Huan, a thillat haltum thillat ding a gan hon lak ate, belam hiam, kel hiam a hih leh, a pa, gensiatbei a lat ding ahi.
english: “‘If his offering is from the flock, from the sheep, or from the goats, for a burnt offering, he shall offer a male without blemish.

paite: Huan, maitam sik, mal lam pang ah TOUPA ma ah a gou ding a: huan, Aron tapa, siampute'n maitam sisan in a kimvel in a theh ding uh ahi.
english: He shall kill it on the north side of the altar before Yahweh. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

paite: Huan, a sem ding a, alu toh, a thau toh; huan, siampu in maitam tung a mei tung a sing ah a koih hoih ding:
english: He shall cut it into its pieces, with its head and its fat. The priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar,

paite: A sungkuate leh a khete bel tui in a sil ding: huan, a pum in siampu in a lan ding a, maitam ah a hal ding ahi: TOUPA a ding a gimlim tak, mei a lat haltum thillat ahi.
english: but the innards and the legs he shall wash with water. The priest shall offer the whole, and burn it on the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

paite: Huan, TOUPA a dia thillat vasa lam haltum thillat a hihleh, a thillat ah vakhute hiam, vapal noute hiam a lat ding ahi.
english: “‘If his offering to Yahweh is a burnt offering of birds, then he shall offer his offering of turtledoves, or of young pigeons.

paite: Huan, siampu in maitam ah a hon tawi ding a, a lu a hektan ding a, maitam ah a hal ding; huan, a sisan maitam pang ah a takkang sak ding;
english: The priest shall bring it to the altar, and wring off its head, and burn it on the altar; and its blood shall be drained out on the side of the altar;

paite: Huan, a gongkholh a mul toh a pai ding a, maitam kiang, suah lam pang a meivu koihna mun ah a pai ding:Huan, a khate a bottol ding a, a tak botzak lou in: huan, siampu in maitam ah, mei tungah a hal ding; huai bel TOUPA a ding a gimlim tak, mei a lat haltum thillat ahi.
english: and he shall take away its crop with its filth, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, in the place of the ashes.

paite: Huan, a khate a bottol ding a, a tak botzak lou in: huan, siampu in maitam ah, mei tungah a hal ding; huai bel TOUPA a ding a gimlim tak, mei a lat haltum thillat ahi.
english: He shall tear it by its wings, but shall not divide it apart. The priest shall burn it on the altar, on the wood that is on the fire. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
